name: Pong Summarization
description: Measures a model's ability to analyze Pong source code and produce a complete structured specification covering invocation, arguments, constants, game rules, rule ordering, and error conditions.

binding_vow.description: The agent receives the full source code of a headless deterministic Pong game. It must produce a JSON genome specifying every detail of the program: invocation template, output contract, CLI arguments (names, types, ranges), numeric constants, game rules (id, trigger, effect), rule execution order, and error conditions. The genome is scored on structural completeness — fraction of required fields and sub-fields present and well-formed.

observation_space.description: { "instruction": string, "source_code": string (full Pong source), "expected_format": object (template showing required genome structure) }

action_space.description: Complete JSON genome specification of the Pong program.

reward.description: Fraction of structural completeness checks passed. 1.0 = all required top-level fields, arguments, constants, rules, and error conditions fully specified.
